note: the players announce combat damage assignment; details are in the subrules

outcome: Each attacker and blocker assigns damage equal to its power, and a creature with power 0 or less assigns none.
An unblocked attacker assigns its damage to the player, planeswalker or battle it attacks, and none if it is attacking nothing.
A blocked attacker assigns all its damage to a single blocker, divides it among several, and assigns none if no blockers remain in combat.
note: the division is a decision; the single-blocker and no-blocker outcomes are mechanical

outcome: A blocking creature assigns its damage to the creature it blocks, divides it among several, and assigns none if it is blocking nothing.

note: an illegal total assignment is rolled back; a procedure on player input

outcome: All assigned combat damage is dealt simultaneously with no chance for spells or abilities in between, so creatures that die still deal their damage.

note: gives the active player priority after damage; priority is covered by rule 117

outcome: Abilities that triggered on combat damage or on the state-based actions after it go on the stack before the active player gets priority.
With a first strike or double strike creature present, only those creatures deal damage in a first combat damage step, then a second step has the remaining creatures and double strikers deal damage.
